title: 2 March 1964: US single release: Twist And Shout
content:
A US-only single, ‘Twist And Shout’, was released on this day. Its b-side was ‘There’s A Place’.

Both songs were taken from the Please Please Me UK album, and the single’s catalogue number was Tollie 9001.

Page last updated: 28 February 2017

Also on this day...

  • 1975: Linda McCartney is arrested for marijuana possession
  • 1975: Radio: John Lennon on WPLJ-FM
  • 1975: Recording: Medicine Jar by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: 3 Legs by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1971: Paul McCartney’s court hearing to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership – day eight
  • 1969: John Lennon and Yoko Ono perform in Cambridge
  • 1969: Paul McCartney produces Mary Hopkin’s Goodbye
  • 1967: Recording, mixing: Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
  • 1964: The Beatles begin filming A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: Television: ABC At Large
  • 1963: The Beatles live: City Hall, Sheffield
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Tower Ballroom, New Brighton, Wallasey
  • 1962: The Beatles live: St John’s Hall, Bootle
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
